## Related issue
Fixes #4978 

## What does this PR do?
- add v1_11_to_v1_12 function to upgrade Meilisearch from v1.11 to v1.12
- Convert the update files from OBKV to ndjson format

issue_context.title: Offline upgrade
issue_context.body:
## Motivation

We cannot implement dumpless upgrade yet.

So in the meantime, we implement help for migration from 
- v1.10 -> v1.11
- v1.11 -> v1.12

As we did for [v1.9 -> v1.10](https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/releases/tag/v1.9.1)

## Impacted teams

Should help support for @meilisearch/cloud-team
